WPT-N00.title: Проверить рабочую базу и сохранить историю
WPT-N00.assignment:
1. Read actual repository/worktree status, current package environment and runtime schema; compare affected files with inspected commit.
2. Confirm previous C01–C07 source/evidence without redoing their implementation. Preserve uncommitted changes and resolve an actual overlapping owner before edits.
3. Export installed plan and back up SQLite using the existing mechanism; keep private paths/tokens out of deliverable.
4. Prepare a stage candidate with tools/prepare_stage_merge.py. Inspect identifiers/base/request before importing by existing API, never replace the current plan with the stage fragment.
5. If the old early-start episode can be located, retain exact node IDs, relevant plan version and sanitized chronology. Otherwise record INCIDENT_NOT_RECONSTRUCTED; this does not stop the independently reproducible dependency regression.

sources/BASELINE.json

WPT-N01.title: Ввести общий формат описаний и свидетельств
WPT-N01.assignment:
1. Implement the versioned x_observability profile and validators from supplied schemas and contracts; preserve unknown fields.
2. Keep assignment executor-facing; add authored intent and output declarations, typed relations and algorithm definitions. No runtime model summaries.
3. Prepare additive migration of known actual DB schema and rebuildable projections, without manufacturing test or dependency success.
4. Introduce capability reporting only for implemented features and stable response basis. Generate schemas from actual code, not drifting hand-edited copies.
5. Build deterministic synthetic fixtures shared by downstream packets; lock field semantics, not incidental helper names.

WPT-N02.title: Показывать настоящие причины ожидания
WPT-N02.assignment:
1. Implement one shared effective-requirement resolver and fingerprint/evidence evaluator; wire all consumers to it.
2. Return start and finish prerequisites separately, provenance and true endpoints for collapsed partial edges.
3. Classify hard blocker/order/inheritance; validate expanded graph including hidden cycles. Preserve legacy link visibility without pretending known availability.
4. Store dependency observations and discrepancies with workspace/predicate provenance; never derive availability solely from status text.
5. Reproduce direct-only /packet omission with nested synthetic regression. Investigate owner incident only from actual retained evidence.

WPT-N03.title: Добавить каталог, план и понятное задание
WPT-N03.assignment:
1. Add metadata-only project catalogue using registered projects, not directory crawling.
2. Create Map/Plan/Algorithms navigation and human/executor Task subtabs; keep assignment and acceptance available.
3. Use one node view/status projection for Map and Plan; show parent reported state plus derived descendant activity without overwriting either.
4. Guard caches, cameras, outline position and requests by service/project/version/generation; handle late cross-project replies.
5. Backfill context-rich intent for current human-visible blocks against fresh plan version. Complete dependency display only after O-DEPS is integrated.

WPT-N04.title: Отфильтровать сообщения без потери истории
WPT-N04.assignment:
1. Implement deterministic native-type classification and error flag; preserve native identity and unknown types.
2. Apply filter in indexed selection before limit/body loading, including deep multi-target deduplication.
3. Implement query-bound opaque cursor with stable tie-breaking; preserve legacy before semantics when unused.
4. Add per-reader multiselect and error facet; use independent query windows, visible-new counters and saved anchors.
5. Ensure ingestion remains unfiltered and an item corrected out of a selected category invalidates its previous reader.
